task: Use Ollama for ambiguous Unilock catalogue matching
specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run; user authorized prompt design and read-only historical evaluation)
setup: Existing Ollama qwen3:4b-instruct, existing test toolchain and bounded isolated Compose. No dependencies, schema migrations or commits.
behaviors: Live Stock Check asks Ollama to resolve ambiguous material descriptions against variants from the scraped Unilock catalogue.
Unique exact and saved matches skip Ollama. Ordinary reads and result polling never call the model.
Only a known candidate SKU with high confidence and compatible explicit colour, dimensions, thickness and handedness may auto-select.
Uncertain, conflicting, invented, duplicate and malformed matches retain manual selection with a clear explanation.
Model outages and timeouts leave stock checks usable through manual selection.
Matching is read-only: no request, response, order, job, cart or catalogue writes. Historical evaluation must not queue live stock jobs.
Changed requests or catalogue data invalidate a pending match. Duplicate calls share bounded cached inference.
Model input contains product descriptors and catalogue variants only, without customer details, credentials, prices or internal notes.
Real historical special-order matching is evaluated against the existing Ollama service from a bounded client, with production data access limited to SELECT.
